---
title: Learn
description: Two tracks in order. Track A teaches CUE from zero. Track B teaches pravo.
---

Start at A1 if you have not used CUE. Start at B1 if you have.

| You are | Begin at |
|---|---|
| New to CUE | [A1, A value is a type](a01-a-value-is-a-type.md) |
| Fluent in CUE | [B1, A first plan](b01-a-first-plan.md) |
| Migrating | [Migrate](../migrate/index.md) |

Each lesson takes about ten minutes. Work in an empty directory.
